toad.name: Mire toadling
toad.blurb: Hops after you and croaks at danger.

fox.name: Ember fox kit
fox.blurb: A fox cub with a tail that glows like coals.

owl.name: Snow owl
owl.blurb: Circles above your head and hoots at night.

drake.name: Baby dragon
drake.blurb: Tiny, fierce, and breathes little sparks.

parrot.name: Tidewake parrot
parrot.blurb: Squawks, flaps and repeats rude pirate words.

pumpkin_slime.name: Pumpkin slime
pumpkin_slime.blurb: A Harvest Fair slime. Smells faintly of pie.

lantern_owl.name: Lantern owl
lantern_owl.blurb: A golden owl that glows softly on Lantern Nights.

snow_fox.name: Snow fox kit
snow_fox.blurb: A Winter Feast fox, white as fresh snow.

horse.name: Chestnut horse
horse.blurb: Steady, fast and cheaper than new boots.

destrier.name: Armored destrier
destrier.blurb: A barded warhorse with a golden crest.

direwolf.name: Frost dire wolf
direwolf.blurb: Bred in Highcairn. Runs on snow like it is road.

raptor.name: Island raptor
raptor.blurb: Tamed on Dragonscale Isle. The fastest thing with legs.

goldsteed.name: Goldhorn steed
goldsteed.blurb: A golden horse from Goldhorn’s herd. Rare drop.

nightmare.name: Mistfang nightmare
nightmare.blurb: A ghost-black horse with burning violet eyes. Rare drop.

bogstrider.name: Bogstrider
bogstrider.blurb: A swamp lizard that runs on mud like it is road. Rare drop.

glacierwolf.name: Glacier wolf
glacierwolf.blurb: Rimeclaw’s pup, grown huge and loyal. Rare drop.

dunestrider.name: Dunestrider
dunestrider.blurb: A sand-gold runner from the deep desert. Rare drop.

tidelizard.name: Tidecrest runner
tidelizard.blurb: Coral-crested and fast as a wave. Rare drop.

emberlizard.name: Emberback runner
emberlizard.blurb: Obsidian scales, lava in its veins. Rare drop.

voidwing.name: Voidwing
voidwing.blurb: A winged steed of the starless sky. Almost nobody has one.

gladiator.name: Gladiator’s warhorse
gladiator.blurb: Earned in the arena by heroes rated 1800 or higher.

phoenix.name: Ashen Phoenix
phoenix.blurb: A great bird of living flame, reborn from its own ashes. The fastest mount in the realm.

knight.name: Sir Aldric
knight.blurb: Taunts enemies onto himself and soaks the hits.

ranger.name: Wren
ranger.blurb: Fires arrows from range at whatever you fight.

cleric.name: Sister Mae
cleric.blurb: Heals you and the party, and smites with holy bolts.
